screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.the_g:
Build a complete PC in survival, then assemble the workstation.

You need:
- 1 Getest Desktop Tower
- 1 Getest Monitor (the controller)
- 1 Getest Toetsenbord
- 1 Getest Muis
- 1 Getest HDMI Kabel
- 1 Getest Power Kabel
- 2 Getest Luidsprekers
- 3 Werkplekbureaus
- Bureaustoelzitting + Backrest
- Transportframes for the desk legs

JEI shows exact recipes. This book is the order of operations.
Every production machine must be a formed multiblock and fed Forge Energy.
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.facto:
1. Craft the machine block, place it facing you.
2. Form its multiblock from Transportframes plus an Energie-invoerluik.
3. Shift-right-click the controller for a hologram (cyan missing, green ok, red wrong).
4. Right-click with a Configurator to auto-place frames/hatches from your inventory.
5. Power it: see the Vastebrandstofgenerator chapter.
6. Open the GUI only after the structuur is geldig.
7. Multi-input machines take several items at once. Single-input machines take one.

Production machines use Transportframes in IRL class silhouettes. Heavy industry (EAF, coke, drill, AOD) gebruiken its own frames.
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.confi:
Craft: iron + redstone + comparator.

Use:
- Right-click any machine controller to auto-build the structure from items in your inventory.
- Shift-right-click to project the hologram without building.
- JEI has a Multiblock Layout category (Configurator icon) for every structure.

Keep stacks of Transportframes and Energie-invoerluikes on you. You will build dozens of machines.
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.first:
Early crafts (vanilla table):
- Crusher: iron, furnace, piston, redstone
- Vastebrandstofgenerator: iron, furnace, redstone
- Configurator: iron, redstone, comparator
- This manual: book + redstone
- Elektrode: 4 Grafietstof (crush graphite ore, or 2 coal + flint)
- Transportframe and Energie-invoerluik: steel-era, after your first ingots

Get iron, copper, coal, redstone, sand, clay, kelp/slime, gold, quartz, and an ink sac. You will burn through all of them.
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.ore_c:
Mine:
- Grafieterts -> Crusher -> 2 Grafietstof (or 2 coal + flint)
- Chromieterts -> Crusher -> 2 Chromietstof
- Tinerts (common, near surface) -> 2 Ruw tin
- Nikkelerts (deep) -> 2 Ruw nikkel
- Vanilla iron, copper, coal, redstone, gold, quartz, emerald

Raw ores smelt or blast straight to ingots.
Crush raw tin/nickel for dust when a recipe needs it.
Elektrode: craft from 4 Grafietstof. One electrode
runs 256 EAF operations; the blast furnace needs none.

Chromietstof smelts to Chromite Staaf.
Craft Chromium Stof from chromite.
Craft Carbon Chunk from coal or charcoal.
Craft Silica Sand (sand+flint), Limestone Stof, Dolomite Stof, Soda Ash, Clay Stof, Chemical Lubricant.

Build the Crusher multiblock (hopper mill of Transportframes plus an Energie-invoerluik) and power it.
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.minin:
Rough totals to build the ENTIRE factory once:
every machine, every structure, one full PC + desk.

- ~2,300 IJzer Erts
- ~420 Koper Erts
- ~420 Coal (coke, carbon, steel)
- ~600 Redstone
- ~150 Goud Erts
- ~7 Chromieterts, ~10 Grafieterts
- ~6 Tinerts, ~1 Nikkelerts (deep)
- 3 Diamonds, 1 Emerald, 2 Quartz
- 50 Emmers crude oil (drilled, not mined)

The first PC pays for the whole factory; later copies
of the tower and peripherals cost only their own parts.
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.solid:
The standalone power source. Right-click it with any
furnace fuel (coal, charcoal, coal coke) to load one item.

Burn time converts to FE at 120 FE/tick, stored in a
60,000 FE buffer. It auto-pushes to adjacent Energy
Input Hatches and machines, and cable mods can drain
it directly. Coal coke burns roughly twice as long
as coal - use it once the Cokesoven is running.

One coal = 1,600 FE. Machines run 20-80 FE/tick, so
budget a few stacks per machine-line day.

Shift-right-click for a buffer status readout.
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.coke_:
Craft Cokesoven Besturing + Cokesoven Frames.
Structure also needs an Invoerbus, Uitvoerbus, and Fluid Uitvoerbus.

Recipe:
Coal (or charcoal) -> Steenkoolcokes + Creosoot

Coke is fuel/reductant for steel and stainless.
Creosoot is a byproduct fluid; bucket it if you need it later.

Shift-click the controller for the hologram. This is your first large multiblock.
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.steel:
Hoogoven (start here, no electrode or water):
IJzer Staaf + Steenkoolcokes -> 2 Staalstaafs
IJzer Staaf + Chromietstof -> Ferrochromium Staaf
IJzer Staaf + Chromium Stof -> Roestvast staal Blend

Structure: EAF frames (3x3 base, six rings, capped top),
Invoerbus on the front, Uitvoerbus right, Energy Hatch over.

Elektrische vlamboogoven:
IJzer Staaf + Steenkoolcokes + 250 mB water -> Staalstaaf
IJzer Staaf + Chromite Staaf + 250 mB water -> Ferrochromium Staaf

Structure: Transportframes in a cylinder, plus Invoerbus, Uitvoerbus, Fluid Input, Fluid Output, Energy Hatch, and Heater on top. Use the hologram.

You need lots of steel: frames, hatches, sheets, cases, coolers, PSU shells.

Craft Staal Plaats in the Staal Plaat Roller (steel ingot in).
Compress ingots <-> blocks/nuggets at the crafting table.
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.stain:
Roestvast is chromium steel: you need the chromite line.

Hoogoven (budget):
Ferrochromium Staaf + Nikkelstof -> Roestvast staal Blend,
then smelt/blast the blend into Roestvast staal Staaf.

AOD Converter (proper):
Ferrochromium Staaf + Nikkelstof + 500 mB oxygen
-> Roestvast staal Staaf directly.

Ferrochromium: blast furnace (iron + chromite dust)
or EAF (iron + chromite ingot). Nickel ore spawns deep.

Zuurstof comes from the Zuurstofconverter multiblock (needs energy + fluid bgebruiken).

Roestvast nuggets are used on CPU packages and lids. Make a stack.
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.crude:
Boorplatform multiblock: controller, drill head, frames, energy hatch, fluid output bus.

It produces Zware ruwe olie. Emmer it.

Crude Fractionator:
Zware ruwe olie Emmer -> Nafta Emmer

Nafta is the backbone of plastics, rubber, ABS, and PVC. Build this before any polymer machines.
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.plast:
Line (each is its own powered multiblock):

Nafta Steam Cracker: Nafta -> Etheen
Chlor-Alkali Cell: Water Emmer + Soda Ash -> Chloor
VCM Reactor: Etheen + Chloor -> Vinylchloride
Plasticizer Unit: Nafta -> Plasticizer
PVC Polymerizer: Vinylchloride + Plasticizer -> PVC Pellets
Rubber Compounder: Nafta -> Rubber Plaat
ABS Polymerizer: Nafta + Rubber Plaat -> ABS Pellets

PVC jackets cables. ABS molds cases, bezels, keycaps, mouse shells, GPU shrouds, speaker cabinets. Rubber is membranes, wheels, gaskets.
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.coppe:
Koper Draad Drawer: Koper Staaf -> 4 Koper Draad
Draad Tinning Bath: Koper Draad + Tin Plating Stof -> Tinned Koper Draad

Craft Koper Foil: 2 copper ingots -> 4 foil.
Craft Tin Plating Stof: 2 Ruw tin + redstone -> 4.

You need tinned wire for transformers, spindle motors, voice coils, power conductors, and IC wire-bonding.
Tin nuggets also make Solder Paste (they replaced iron).
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.fiber:
This makes FR4 for every circuit board.

1. Batching Mixer: Silica Sand + Limestone Stof + Dolomite Stof + Soda Ash + Clay Stof -> Raw Glas Batch
2. Refractory Melting Furnace: Raw Glas Batch -> Vloeibaar glas
3. Extrusion (needs Platinum Alloy Bushing Plate machine): Vloeibaar glas -> Glas Filament
4. Chemical Sizing Applicator: Filament + water -> Sized Glas Filament
5. Gathering Winder: Sized Filament -> Glas Spool
6. Drying Oven: Spool -> Dried Glas Spool
7. Roving Creel: 4 Dried Glas Spools -> Glas Roving
8. Textile Loom: 2 Glas Roving -> Fiberglass Fabric

Craft Raw FR4 Laminate: Fiberglass Fabric + Chemical Lubricant + Slime Ball.

Budget route: 4 Chopped Strand Mat -> 1 Raw FR4 Laminate
(mat is a Strand Chopping Machinery byproduct; skips the loom).
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.bare_:
Craft CAD Layout (2 paper + redstone + ink sac).
Design Engineering Station: CAD Layout -> Verified Gerber File.

Then the board line, in order:
1. Industrial Shear: Raw FR4 -> Sheared FR4
2. Decontamination Oven: Sheared -> Baked FR4
3. Hydraulic Cladding Pers: Baked FR4 + Koper Foil -> Koper Clad Laminate
4. Photo Resist Applicator: Clad + Photo Resist Polymer -> Inner Layer Patterned Bord
5. UV LDI Imager: patterned board + Verified Gerber
6. Chemical Developing Wash -> Developed Inner Layer
7. Acidic Etching Sprayer -> Etched Inner Layer
8. Alkaline Stripping Station -> Stripped Inner Layer
9. Craft Multi-Layer Stackup / Prepreg, then Vacuum Lamination Pers -> Laminated PCB Core
10. X-ray Alignment Drill -> Geboord PCB
11. Electroless Plating Bath -> Electroless Koper Gecoat PCB

Continue:

The precision machines each need 1 Platinum Alloy Bushing
Plate (gold + steel): X-ray Alignment Drill, Pick and
Place Robot, CNC Router.

12. Outer photoresist + LDI
13. Koper Electroplating Tank -> Electroplated PCB
14. Tin Plating Tank (needs Tin Plating Stof) -> Tin Plated PCB
15. Final etch -> Final Etched PCB
16. Tin strip -> Tin Stripped PCB
17. Soldermask Flooder or UV Pad Exposure + Soldermask Resin -> Gemaskeerd PCB
18. Inkjet Silkscreen Printer -> Silkscreened PCB
19. Surface Finish Station -> Afgewerkt PCB Panel
20. Flying Probe Tester -> Getest PCB Panel
21. CNC Router -> Gefreesd PCB

SMT:
Craft Solder Paste (iron nuggets + redstone + slime).
22. Solder Paste Printer: Gefreesd PCB + Solder Paste -> Stencil Printed PCB
23. Pick and Place: Stencil Printed + Redstone (-> Geplaatst PCBA)
24. Multi-zone Reflow Oven -> Gesoldeerd PCBA
25. AOI Verification Station -> Final PCBA

Final PCBA is the blank used by motherboard, GPU, PSU, SSD, keyboard, mouse, and monitor boards.
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.silic:
Wafer Blank Pers: Silica Sand -> Silicon Wafer
Wafer Dicing Saw: Wafer -> Silicon Die
Die Attach Bonder: Die + Koper Foil -> Attached Die
Draad Bonding Machine: Attached Die + Tinned Koper Draad -> Bonded Die
IC Transfer Mold: Bonded Die + ABS Pellets -> Molded IC
IC Tester: Molded IC -> Getest IC

Every chip in the PC starts as a Getest IC. Make many; binning consumes them one-for-one.
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.ic_pa:
IC Binning Station recipes (Getest IC + extra):

- Roestvast staal Klompje -> CPU Behuizing
- Redstone -> GPU Behuizing
- Koper Foil -> Chipset Behuizing
- Carbon Chunk -> NAND Behuizing
- Staalklompje -> HDD Besturing Behuizing
- Glas -> Display Besturing Behuizing
- Goud Klompje -> MCU Behuizing
- Quartz -> DRAM Behuizing (or craft DRAM from gold/redstone/quartz)

Craft SPD EEPROM: gold nuggets + redstone + emerald.

You need at least: 1 CPU, 1 GPU, 1 chipset, 1 display controller, 1 MCU (keyboard) + 1 MCU (mouse) + 1 MCU (SSD), NAND, HDD controller, and DRAM for RAM and VRAM.
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.ram.b:
Two DRAM sources: craft (gold/redstone/quartz) or bin Getest ICs with quartz.

Pick and Place Robot:
Final PCBA + DRAM Behuizing + SPD EEPROM -> Unprogrammed RAM Module

Flying Probe Tester:
Unprogrammed RAM Module -> RAM Stick

You need a RAM Stick for desktop assembly (DIMM Install Pers).
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.mothe:
CPU Socket Pers: Final PCBA + Staalklompje -> Socketed Motherboard
Expansion Slot Inserter: Socketed Motherboard + Koper Foil -> Slotted Motherboard
Chipset Placer: Slotted Motherboard + Chipset Behuizing -> Motherboard PCBA
Motherboard ICT: Motherboard PCBA -> Getest Motherboard

This Getest Motherboard is the start of tower assembly.
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.cpu.b:
IHS Bonder: CPU Behuizing + Roestvast staal Klompje -> Lidded CPU
CPU Burn-In Chamber: Lidded CPU -> Getest CPU

Later, Thermal Paste Dispenser mounts it:
Getest Motherboard + Getest CPU + Chemical Lubricant -> Bord With CPU
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.gpu.b:
GPU Substrate SMT: Final PCBA + GPU Behuizing -> GPU Core Bord
VRAM Populator: GPU Core Bord + DRAM Behuizing -> GPU Populated Bord
GPU Cooler Pers: Staalstaaf + Rubber Plaat -> GPU Cooler
GPU Shroud Molder: ABS Pellets -> GPU Shroud
GPU Assembly Jig: Populated Bord + Cooler + Shroud -> Gemonteerd GPU
GPU Tester: Gemonteerd GPU -> Getest GPU
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.psu.b:
Transformer Winder: Tinned Koper Draad + Staalstaaf -> PSU Transformer
PSU SMT: Final PCBA + PSU Transformer -> PSU Bord
PSU Case Stamper: Staalstaaf -> PSU Shell
PSU Final Assembly: PSU Bord + PSU Shell + PVC Pellets -> Gemonteerd PSU
PSU Load Tester: Gemonteerd PSU -> Getest PSU
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.hdd.b:
Platter Polisher: IJzer Staaf -> HDD Platter
Magnetic Sputter: Platter + Redstone -> Gecoat Platter
Spindle Motor Winder: Tinned Koper Draad + Staalklompje -> Spindle Motor
Head Stack Assembler: Staalklompje + Silicon Die -> Head Stack
HDD HEPA Sealer: Gecoat Platter + Spindle Motor + Head Stack -> Verzegeld HDD
HDD Servo Writer: Verzegeld HDD + HDD Besturing Behuizing -> Geprogrammeerd HDD
HDD Burn-In: Geprogrammeerd HDD -> Getest HDD

Either a Getest HDD or Getest SSD can be installed; both recipes output Bord With Storage.
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.ssd.b:
NAND Stacker: NAND Behuizing -> NAND Stack
SSD SMT: Final PCBA + NAND Stack + MCU Behuizing -> SSD Bord
SSD Firmware Programmer: SSD Bord -> Geprogrammeerd SSD
SSD Case Welder: Geprogrammeerd SSD + ABS Pellets -> Gemonteerd SSD
SSD Validator: Gemonteerd SSD -> Getest SSD
Staal Plaat Roller: Staalstaaf -> Staal Plaat
Case Stamping Pers: Staal Plaat -> Case Chassis
Powder Coater: Case Chassis -> Gecoat Chassis
Front Panel Molder: ABS Pellets -> Case Front Panel
Case Assembly Jig: Gecoat Chassis + Front Panel + Rubber Plaat -> PC Case
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.tower:
Install in this exact order:

1. Thermal Paste Dispenser: Getest Motherboard + Getest CPU + Chemical Lubricant -> Bord With CPU
2. DIMM Install Pers: Bord With CPU + RAM Stick -> Bord With Memory
3. GPU Install Bench: Bord With Memory + Getest GPU -> Bord With GPU
4. Storage Install Bay: Bord With GPU + Getest HDD or Getest SSD -> Bord With Storage
5. PSU Install Bench: Bord With Storage + Getest PSU -> Draadd Internals
6. Tower Final Assembly: Draadd Internals + PC Case -> Gemonteerd Desktop
7. Desktop Power-On Test: Gemonteerd Desktop -> Getest Desktop Tower

The tower is a placeable block. Keep it for the workstation.
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.monit:
LCD Glas Washer: Glas -> Cleaned LCD Glas
Color Filter Printer: Cleaned Glas -> Color Filter Glas
Liquid Crystal Filler: Color Filter Glas + Chemical Lubricant -> Filled LCD Cell
Polarizer Laminator: Filled Cell -> Polarized Panel
Backlight Assembler: ABS Pellets + Redstone -> LED Backlight
LCD Cell Bonder: Polarized Panel + LED Backlight -> LCD Module
Monitor Besturing SMT: Final PCBA + Display Besturing Behuizing -> Monitor Logic Bord
Monitor Bezel Molder: ABS Pellets -> Monitor Bezel
Monitor Final Assembly: LCD Module + Logic Bord + Bezel -> Gemonteerd Monitor
Monitor Burn-In: Gemonteerd Monitor -> Getest Monitor

The Getest Monitor is the workstation controller. Face it toward the chair when placing.
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.keybo:
Keycap Injection Molder: ABS Pellets -> Keycaps
Membrane Plaat Printer: Rubber Plaat -> Key Membrane
Toetsenbord PCB SMT: Final PCBA + MCU Behuizing -> Toetsenbord PCB
Toetsenbord Plate Stamper: Staal Plaat -> Toetsenbord Plate
Toetsenbord Assembly: Toetsenbord PCB + Key Membrane + Keycaps -> Gemonteerd Toetsenbord
Toetsenbord Tester: Gemonteerd Toetsenbord + Toetsenbord Plate -> Getest Toetsenbord
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.mouse:
Muis Shell Molder: ABS Pellets -> Muis Shell
Optical Sensor SMT: Final PCBA + MCU Behuizing -> Muis Sensor Bord
Scroll Wheel Molder: Rubber Plaat -> Scroll Wheel
Muis Assembly: Shell + Sensor Bord + Scroll Wheel -> Gemonteerd Muis
Muis Tester: Gemonteerd Muis -> Getest Muis
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.hdmi_:
Pair Twinner: Tinned Koper Draad -> Getwist paar
HDMI Shield Braider: Getwist paar + Koper Draad -> Afgeschermd HDMI Core
HDMI Jacket Extruder: Afgeschermd Core + PVC Pellets -> Ommanteld HDMI
HDMI Connector Molder: ABS Pellets + Goud Klompje -> HDMI Connector
HDMI Termination Pers: Ommanteld HDMI + Connector -> Gemonteerd HDMI
HDMI Continuity Tester: Gemonteerd HDMI -> Getest HDMI Kabel
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.power:
Power Conductor Strander: Tinned Koper Draad -> Power Conductor
Power Jacket Extruder: Power Conductor + PVC Pellets -> Ommanteld Power Cord
IEC Connector Molder: ABS Pellets + Staalklompje -> IEC Connector
Power Kabel Overmolder: Ommanteld Cord + IEC Connector -> Gemonteerd Power Kabel
Hi-Pot Tester: Gemonteerd Power Kabel -> Getest Power Kabel
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.speak:
You need TWO tested speakers.

Luidspreker Magnet Sinter: IJzer Staaf + Redstone -> Luidspreker Magnet
Voice Coil Winder: Tinned Koper Draad -> Voice Coil
Cone Former: Paper + Chemical Lubricant -> Luidspreker Cone
Driver Assembler: Magnet + Voice Coil + Cone -> Luidspreker Driver
Cabinet Molder: ABS Pellets -> Luidspreker Cabinet
Luidspreker Final Assembly: Driver + Cabinet + Rubber Plaat -> Gemonteerd Luidspreker
Luidspreker Anechoic Test: Gemonteerd Luidspreker -> Getest Luidspreker
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.desk_:
Craft at the table:
- Werkplekbureau: steel sheets + planks (make 3)
- Bureaustoelzitting: steel + wool
- Bureaustoelleuning: steel + wool

Transportframes are the desk legs. Craft extras from steel.
screen.tech_revised.manual.chapter.works:
Place the Getest Monitor facing the chair. It is the controller.

Relative to the monitor (look at JEI hologram / shift-click):

Desk surface:
- Desks on over, right, and behind the monitor
- Luidsprekers on the back-over and back-right corners
- Toetsenbord in front of the monitor
- Muis on the front-over
- HDMI on the front-right

Under the desk:
- Transportframe legs
- Getest Desktop Tower under the keyboard
- Getest Power Kabel one block further under the HDMI side

Chair:
- Seat two blocks in front of the monitor
- Backrest on top of the seat

Right-click the monitor with a Configurator, or shift-click for the hologram. When valid you get "Workstation structuur is geldig" and can open the VM screen.
